# Observer Patch Holography Papers

Release: r2019
Released: August 13, 2026

This page lists the first-party HTML and PDF URLs for the OPH paper stack.

## Deriving Standard Model Gauge Structure from Observer Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antoine Visser, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, Asimov Labs
- Category: Gauge structure
- Summary: Examines two mathematical routes from observer overlap to the symmetry structure used by the Standard Model. The physical identification of that structure is an open question.

## Deriving the Particle Zoo from Observer Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Maarten Antoine Visser, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, Asimov Labs
- Category: Particles
- Summary: Explores whether the observer-consistency framework can account for particles and physical constants. Several comparisons are mathematical or conditional, and their connection to measured physics remains open.

## From Observer Consensus to Standard Physics

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antoine Visser, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill, William T. Glynn
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, Asimov Labs
- Category: Flagship introduction
- Summary: An introduction to Observer Patch Holography. It asks whether limited systems that compare records and repair disagreement can explain parts of quantum theory, gravity, and particle physics.

## Paradise as Fixed-Point Consensus

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/paradise-as-fixed-point-consensus/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/paradise-as-fixed-point-consensus/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Observer continuation
- Summary: The OPH continuation and meaning paper. It reads existence, observer continuation, record consistency, justice, resurrection, and paradise through fixed-point consensus.

## Reality as a Consensus Protocol

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Kai Xue, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Simulation theory
- Summary: Develops the mathematics of shared records, disagreement repair, and stable outcomes among limited observers.

## Recovering Observer Spacetime and Einstein Dynamics from Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antoine Visser, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, Asimov Labs
- Category: Gravity
- Summary: Explores how shared observer records could lead to spacetime and gravity. The paper states the mathematical results and the conditions needed to connect them to physical gravity.

## Screen Microphysics and Observer Synchronization

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Maarten Antoine Visser, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, Asimov Labs
- Category: Screen physics
- Summary: Studies a finite observer model with records, synchronization, measurement, and possible hardware evidence. It separates mathematical results from open questions about their physical realization.

## Compact Proof Of Oph

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/compact-proof-of-oph/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/compact-proof-of-oph/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: OPH overview
- Summary: A short guide to the main idea behind Observer Patch Holography, its mathematical results, and the physical questions that remain open.
